text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Customs procedure at Macedonian-Greek border simplified, allowing easier transport of all kinds of goods. Railway transport prices between Macedonia and Greece went down.
- Special import tax to be paid at border for coffee, alcohol and other luxury products. Level of tax depends on product.

- New unprofessional tourist agencies ruined New Year and Christmas holidays for their clients. Many of them greeted the New Year in airport halls, bus and railway statins in Romania, Israel and Morocco.
